intro.title: The Common Grounds Media Matrix
intro.text: A smooth, slide-based presentation comparing the two countries. It charts shared seafaring history, culinary crossovers and language links, and also covers family, faith, dress, crafts, architecture, music, celebrations and people.

ui.hint: Swipe, scroll or use the arrow keys

slides.title: Ships and Songs
slides.text: Sailors sang to keep time at the oars and to ease the long voyages. Bahrain's Fijiri is the chanted art of the pearl-diving ships, with drums and tambourine, while Tunisia's coastal communities have their own fishermen's songs. The oud, the instrument of Arab music, is heard in both countries.
